items.title: Tre Tucker: Strikes for long TD in loss
items.text:
Tucker secured five of 12 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Just under 300 passing yards in loss
items.text:
Cousins completed 26 of 44 passes for 295 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing three times for six yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

items.title: Blake Corum: Over 100 scrimmage yards in win
items.text:
Corum rushed 17 times for 93 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for eight yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Cools off in Week 7
items.text:
Coker caught one of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers.
